Lighting is bright and flat studio-style with green and purple digital outlines surrounding the characters. (2) The long-haired man interacts with a white digital interface, drawing a phallic outline with a black stroke. He sticks his tongue out playfully while gesturing at the screen. The background is purely white during this phase. (3) A highly detailed black-and-white graphic illustration of a woman with an afro, glasses, and starry eyes appears. The two men reappear in the corners of the frame, pointing at specific sections of the artwork such as the eyes and mouth. (4) A rapid photo montage shows a young woman and the long-haired man posing in front of a colorful graffiti wall. They wear black and pink T-shirts featuring the afro-girl artwork. The setting is an urban outdoor street with natural daylight.
